title: Async Token-Bucket Rate Limiter
instructions: Implement `TokenBucket` in `ratelimit.py`. It refills `rate` tokens per second up to `burst`, starts full, and `await acquire(cost)` waits exactly `(cost - tokens) / rate` seconds before deducting. Waiters are served in arrival order, the clock and sleep functions are injectable, and a small epsilon keeps the loop from spinning on floating-point error.

evidence.label: The first `burst` calls are free, then each call waits (cost - tokens) / rate
Time that has passed refills tokens and shortens the wait
Never banks more than `burst` tokens after a long idle period
Serves waiters first come, first served
A large request is not starved by later small ones
Total elapsed time for N calls matches the configured rate
Raises ValueError for rate <= 0 or burst < 1
Raises ValueError for cost <= 0 or cost > burst
Works with the default monotonic clock and asyncio.sleep
